534: A fort cannot protect someone who is full of fear. In the same way, nothing good can help someone who is careless.
540: It is easy to get what you set your mind on, as long as you keep thinking about it and never let it slip from your mind.
551: A king who keeps troubling his people and doing wrong to them is crueler than a murderer.
569: A king who does not build a strong fort ahead of time will be filled with fear when war comes, and will quickly fall.
574: Eyes that do not show the right amount of kindness may sit in a face, but what good do they really do?
576: People who have eyes but never look kindly at others are no better than trees standing in the ground.
596: Let all your thoughts be about rising higher. Even if you do not reach your goal, aiming high is as good as reaching it.
609: When a person drives out the laziness that controls them, the faults that have crept into their family and their own life will go away.
